location_lifecycle.label: Office Lifecycle
location_lifecycle.help: Operational lifecycle of a office or practice location. Occupancy, booking availability, and record activation are separate.

planned.help: The office or practice location is being prepared and has not started operating.

operational.help: The office or practice location is operating. This does not indicate vacant space or booking availability.

under_maintenance.help: The office or practice location is undergoing maintenance; operating restrictions are managed separately.

temporarily_closed.help: Operations at the office or practice location are paused with an intention to reopen.

closed.help: Operations have ended at the office or practice location.
